Markets.title: NMDC shares decline 4% after Q1 results. Should you buy, sell or hold the stock?
Markets.summary: NMDC shares fell 4% even though its Q1FY27 profit and revenue both rose 2%, reaching Rs 2,007 crore and Rs 6,795 crore, respectively. Although iron ore production jumped 26% to 151.17 lakh tonnes, sales increased by only 2% to 117.30 lakh tonnes.

Markets.title: How India's digital infrastructure opened global markets to Indian investors
Markets.summary: Indian residents' outward remittances reached a record USD 31.73 billion by fiscal year 2023-24. Digital reforms and infrastructure upgrades streamlined the process by enabling online Form A2 submissions, remote identification, and the removal of value caps.

Markets.title: PhysicsWallah shares rally 8% after Q1 loss narrows, revenue rises 24% YoY. Should you buy?
Markets.summary: PhysicsWallah shares rose 8% after the edtech company reported a narrowed Q1 loss and a 24% year-on-year increase in revenue. Brokerage JM Financial maintained a bullish rating, highlighting strong online growth and improving profitability.

Markets.title: US Stock Market: Tiger Global trims big tech bets, adds AMD and SpaceX in Q2
Markets.summary: In the second quarter, Tiger Global reduced its investments in major technology companies like Alphabet, Nvidia, and Microsoft while completely selling its stake in Netflix. During the same period, the fund increased its Intel holdings and bought new shares in AMD and SpaceX.

Markets.title: Global Market: German companies turn cautious on new US investments amid tariff risks
Markets.summary: German companies cut direct investments in the US by nearly two-thirds during the first half of 2026. This sharp decline was driven by growing uncertainty surrounding tariffs, trade, and US economic policy.

Geo-Political.title: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, arrived in Israel following rare discussions with Hamas concerning a Gaza peace plan. Kushner is scheduled to meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later on Monday.

Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian strikes killed six people and injured four others, including a 14-year-old child, in Russia's Belgorod region. The acting governor of the region reported the casualties following the attacks.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced that the U.S. will reduce military drills with South Korea. He cited his strong relationship with North Korea's leader and South Korea's decision not to participate in the Iran war as reasons for the reduction.

Geo-Political.title: Heroes actress Hayden Panettiere dies aged 36
Geo-Political.summary: Hayden Panettiere, the actress known for her roles in the television shows Heroes and Nashville, has died at the age of 36. Her film credits also included appearances in Remember the Titans and Raising Helen.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
Geo-Political.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the deadliest in the country's history. This record-setting epidemic is caused by a rare strain of the virus known as Bundibugyo.

Geo-Political.summary: Record rainfall has struck a South Korean city, triggering a landslide that resulted in one death. This event is part of a broader weather pattern causing heavy downpours across large areas of East and Southeast Asia.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's wholesale price index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for primary articles and manufactured products both increased compared to June.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation decreased to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This moderation in price increases may give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

India.summary: Shehzad Poonawalla has resigned from the BJP, citing pressing financial and personal issues. Although he initially submitted his resignation on July 30, the party initially asked him to reconsider his decision.

India.title: "Fix Else I Will Have To Protest Again", Ramdev Warns Centre Over 'Scams'
India.summary: Yoga guru Ramdev has warned the central government that he will launch another protest unless it addresses corruption in the selection process for government jobs. He alleged that bribery and money power are currently influencing these official appointments.

India.title: 'Dimagi Naxal Party' Instagram Page Gets 1.6 Lakh Followers In 24 Hours
India.summary: An Instagram page named 'Dimagi Naxal Party' gained 1.6 lakh followers within 24 hours of its creation this month. Account information shows that the page was opened in November and its username was changed once.

India.title: "Uncontrollable Crowd": 7 Killed, Many Injured In Stampede At Bihar Temple
India.summary: A stampede at a temple in Bihar resulted in seven deaths and numerous injuries due to an uncontrollable crowd. Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary called the incident tragic and directed the administration to provide proper and prompt treatment to the injured.

India.title: 16-Year-Old Lakshmanan Meyyappan Becomes World's Youngest Chartered Accountant
India.summary: Sixteen-year-old Lakshmanan Meyyappan has set a Guinness World Record in Dubai by becoming the world's youngest male Chartered Accountant. He achieved this professional milestone at the age of 16 years and 141 days.

India.title: Boost Cooking Gas Production: India To Local Refineries Amid Hormuz Crisis
India.summary: The Indian government has ordered local refineries to maximize their cooking gas production beyond normal minimum levels. This directive is a response to the ongoing crisis in the Strait of Hormuz.
